blocks.text: Caprice Cayetano, Ashtine Olviga and Fyang Smith were among the artists recognized at the 10th edition of the RAWR Awards, which honored personalities and productions that made a mark on Filipino audiences this year. Cayetano, who was present at the ceremony, took home the Breakthrough Artist of the Year award, while Smith, who wasn’t able to attend the ceremony due to a prior commitment, bagged the Favorite Newbie trophy. The popular JMFyang pairing, composed of Smith and her onscreen partner, JM Ibarra, also won Love Team of the Year.
